371639.claim: C5 lexicographic power plus 5^k isolated vertices (and hub variant) violates Clow-Kumar-Pragada Conjecture 7.5 for every c; full Lean (111 declarations)
371639.root_adjudication: HOLD / not credited: counterexample relies on padding (isolated vertices or padding plus hub) to drive |V(G)|/|V(H)| to about 1 while chi_f stays (5/2)^k; unpadded C5 powers and vertex-transitive graphs satisfy the inequality with c>1. This is an elementary formulation defect (domain correction) under the written exclusion standard, consistent with the 370838 exclusion.
371639.reopen_if: A padding-free counterexample, e.g. among chi-vertex-critical graphs or graphs without isolated/dominated padding, with full Lean endpoint and independent review

known.372105: 6-vertex counterexample public in arXiv:2610.08042, 2610.27133, Omega D5 and issue #8518
